title: Jinin Farko da Aka Zuba a Cikin Hassada
intro: Ka yi tunanin farkon zamanin ɗan adam, lokacin da duniya duka iyali ɗaya ce. Ka kalli yadda ake miƙa hadayu biyu a gaban Allah - ɗaya ya karɓa, ɗayan kuma ya ƙi. Hassada ta yi tushe a cikin zuciya, kuma ana raɗa barazana cikin fushi. Abin da zai biyo baya zai bar alama a tarihi har abada, har ma ƙaramin tsuntsu zai zama malami.
clues: Ni na cikin iyali na farko a duniya.
Na miƙa hadaya ga Allah, amma nawa ba a karɓi ba yayin da aka karɓi ɗayan hadayar.
Na yi magana cikin hassada kuma na yi barazanar kashe rai.
Ni ne na yi kisan gilla na farko a duniya.
Na ga hankaka yana tono ƙasa don ya nuna mini yadda ake ɓoye gawa.
Na yi nadama cike da baƙin ciki, na kuma zama cikin waɗanda suka yi hasarar abin da hannuna ya aikata.

identity.label: Wanene Ni?
options: Kabil (Ka'ab), ɗan Adam
Samiri, mai yin maraƙin
Namrud, azzalumin da ya yi jayayya da Ibrahim,
Azar, mai yin gumaka
Kan'an, ɗan Nuhu da aka nutsar

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Kisan wani ɗan'uwa saboda hassada bayan an ƙi bayar da tayin
Gina hasumiya mai tsayi don kallon sammai
Yin ƙera ɗan maraƙi na zinariya don bauta
Ina neman teburi daga sama
Jagorancin rundunar giwaye don lalata Ka'aba
trial.answer: Kisan wani ɗan'uwa saboda hassada bayan an ƙi bayar da tayin

location.label: Babban Sinadari
options: Hankaka yana tono ƙasa don nuna binnewa
Ɗan maraƙi na zinariya wanda ya faɗi
Babban jirgi a kan ruwan ambaliyar ruwa
Sanda wadda ta zama maciji
Teburin da aka shimfiɗa tare da abinci daga sama
location.answer: Hankaka yana tono ƙasa don nuna binnewa

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Ya zama mai nadama kuma yana cikin masu hasara
An nutsar da shi cikin babban ambaliyar ruwa
An haɗiye shi da ƙasa da taska
An yi min kuturta tsawon shekaru bakwai
An ba shi mulki mai iko da iska
outcome.answer: Ya zama mai nadama kuma yana cikin masu hasara

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
